The healthcare sector, while experiencing some volatility due to regulatory changes and pharmaceutical pricing pressures, is expected to benefit from demographic shifts and an aging population. These sectoral trends may lead to increased investment and job creation, which could positively impact global markets. However, ESG concerns in the tech sector arise from the production and disposal of e-waste, data protection, and employee welfare standards, while the healthcare sector faces challenges related to unequal access and pharmaceutical marketing. materials.analysis: Gold prices have exhibited a recent downward trend, but based on historical data, it tends to perform well during periods of high inflation. Silver prices have been more volatile but have shown a moderate positive correlation with inflation. As a general rule, gold tends to hold its value better than other assets during periods of inflation, whereas silver can be more impacted by economic growth and industrial demand. Considering the current inflation expectations, both gold and silver may offer some protection against inflationary pressures. However, their prices may fluctuate over the short term due to various market factors. Based on moderate inflation expectations and some softening in the gold price, we suggest holding and adjusting the allocation to the optimal level.
